title: Merging Paper B analytics into Paper A finance certifies a kill of a run-survivor length at floor 10^6
statement: Some Paper B mechanism — kernel cancellation, equidistribution of {m^{3/2}}, exact linearization, suffix-weight bands, or spectral constraints on the closed cycle wave — supplies a certified improvement factor of at least RHS/theta on at least one run-survivor length L at descent floor 10^6, excluding it as a cycle length.
counterexamples: required-improvement profile over the 141 parity leftovers at n=10^6+1 (cycle_finance/prefix_weights.json): min 1.04 at L=99561, median 1.96, 32.5 at the first survivor L=25781, 223 at L=50508; the affine-family seeds are the hardest points
exact/bounded suffix weights give at most an uncertified 9/8 (juggler_cycle_prefix_weight_leftover_killer)
spectral constraints are arrangement-independent: moment 1/16 for both the mechanical necklace and the bunched itinerary (juggler_cycle_fourier_leftover_killer)
cycle candidates are not mechanical, so Sturmian/Denjoy-Koksma itinerary bounds cannot kill a length (juggler_christoffel_one_parameter; L=19 median Hamming 6)
ambient-to-generated equidistribution transfer fails in the tested form (juggler_parity_discrepancy_transfer)
linear-forms lower bounds are weaker than the exact finance gap on every tested length (juggler_cycle_gap_baker)
a single hypothetical cycle is a specific point, blocked by the derandomization obstruction of Paper B's own kernel program (J-derandomization-obstruction; BB/GG/JJ)
first_seen: Paper A x Paper B merge assessment
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / analytic floor-defect program
notes: Directed consolidation, zero new experiments; every merge flank maps onto an archived refutation. The surviving formulation is an n-power-saving lower bound on |3^o - 2^L| along the three affine families, using the cycle floor n as a parameter. Not a halt theorem, not a leftover-itinerary census, no Paper A or Paper B edit, no new Lean, no floor raise.
tested_range: 141 parity leftovers at n=10^6+1 via prefix_weights.json; archived kills cited by id; no new computation beyond the RHS/theta profile
